Neutralizing Antibody Titer Assay.readouts: FRNT-mNG50 neutralizing antibody titres against WA1/2020 and B.1.351

Flow Cytometry.readouts: spike-specific CD4 and CD8 T cell frequencies, intracellular cytokines (IFNγ, TNF, IL-2, IL-4), IL-21+CD154+ CD4 T cells, CXCR5+ CD4 T cells

CyTOF.readouts: immune cell frequencies including intermediate monocytes and phospho-signaling markers pSTAT1 and pSTAT3

Olink.readouts: cytokine concentrations including IFNγ, CXCL10 and IL-10

Bulk RNA-seq.readouts: differentially expressed genes and enriched antiviral, interferon, dendritic cell, Toll-like receptor, monocyte and neutrophil transcriptional modules

CITE-seq.readouts: single-cell transcriptomes and antibody-derived epitopes, cell clusters including interferon-stimulated myeloid cluster C8

Q-PCR.readouts: PCR quantification after IFNγ or plasma stimulation

Luminex xMAP.readouts: IgG autoantibodies and anticytokine antibodies measured as mean fluorescence intensity
